patch.value: Support explicit unset scope in published admission oracle comparisons

Published CLI-driven fixture creates and previews use explicit unset parent and assignee rather than placeholder tokens; Native admission matches the new published oracle without inferring ambient focus or accepting unsupported relationship mutations; Focused tests and behavioral revert prove compatibility on the pinned and proposed oracle versions without changing dependency pins

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Verified failing PR #122 at job 127715288185: SDK create and previewItemMutations now reject parent and assignee placeholder strings. A real no-git oracle probe accepts unset=[parent,assignee] and rejects the old sentinels. Migrate the canonical native admission request to explicit unset fields, refuse supplied scope and unsupported clear operations, update all CLI-driven fixtures, and compare against both the unchanged pinned oracle and the proposed 2026.11.2 oracle. Dependency manifests remain unchanged.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Focused native tests pass 23 of 23 and integration tests pass 12 of 12 against the pinned oracle. A disposable behavioral revert of prepare_create fails the new explicit-unset regression (exit 101), and the fixed function passes it. Testing the proposed oracle then exposed a separate published preview change: configured closure creates with active roles are admitted without a close reason. Such closure operations are explicitly outside the native scalar contract, which retains its close_reason_required refusal. Preserve that behavior and assert both unsupported closure forms independently instead of making the supported-slice parity claim cover them. Convert the existing oracle harness to TypeScript and include it in the harness typecheck.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: The migrated TypeScript driver passes strict harness typecheck. Against the proposed 2026.11.2 SDK it passes 108 supported admission cases, both JSON and TOON renderers, plus 12 identity-path fixtures. Both configured closure forms retain independent native close_reason_required assertions. The unchanged pinned SDK also passed the 23 native unit and 12 integration tests before migration; a targeted run of the typed oracle integration is verifying the final driver. The dependency manifest and lockfile remain unchanged. The closure-preview divergence is retained separately in pm-rust-oracle-close-preview.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: The typed oracle harness lives beside the pinned oracle package and uses the public SDK type import, so both runtime and declarations resolve that package version rather than an ancestor installation. The existing guarded SDK loader is retained, and the harness typecheck includes the moved driver.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Final focused evidence: 23 native admission unit tests pass, the 12-test admission integration suite passes, and the moved public-import oracle integration passes 1 of 1 on the unchanged pin. The proposed 2026.11.2 SDK passes strict typecheck and 108 supported oracle cases plus 12 identity fixtures through the same driver. Both configured closure creates and updates retain independent native refusal assertions. The isolated prepare_create behavioral revert fails and the fixed function passes. Full npm/Bun aggregate gates remain queued; no dependency pin or threshold changes were made.

value.text: Focused regression, local typecheck and isolated behavioral revert pass. value.command:
python3 -c 'import os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
candidates=list(Path('"'"'target/llvm-cov-target/debug/build/pm-rust'"'"').glob('"'"'*/out/build_script_build'"'"'))
assert len(candidates)==1, candidates
for target, expected in [('"'"'gnu'"'"','"'"''"'"'),('"'"'msvc'"'"','"'"'cargo:rustc-link-arg-bin=pm-rust=/STACK:8388608\n'"'"')]:
    env=dict(os.environ, CARGO_CFG_TARGET_ENV=target, LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=str(root/'"'"'target/llvm-cov-target'"'"'/f'"'"'{root.name}-%p-%4m.profraw'"'"'))
    result=subprocess.run([str(candidates[0])],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
    assert result.stdout==expected, (target,result.stdout)
    assert result.stderr=='"'"''"'"', result.stderr
    print(f'"'"'build-script {target}: passed'"'"')
'
